newsitem.title: USA: BPA cuts firm off-peak power by 50c/MWh for Thurs.
newsitem.headline: BPA cuts firm off-peak power by 50c/MWh for Thurs.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) reversed the price increase instituted on Tuesday and cut prices for next-day firm off-peak power by 50 cents per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Wednesday.
But BPA continued to hold off from offering firm or non-firmpower during peak and shoulder hours.
Firm off-peak power was offered at $9.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Thursday, down from $9.50 for Wednesday.
For Thursday, BPA continued to offer displacement power at $7.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST.
Prices for non-firm power during off-peak hours on Thursday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
